subject: Re: Kickoff: COMISR for user-upload enhancement
body:
Hi both,

Status: vid4 reproduction is done. On the lr_crf25 inputs (calendar, city, foliage, walk) our numbers match the release checkpoint, and against a strong non-compression-aware baseline we're seeing +0.6 dB PSNR average on the compressed inputs — the whole point of the method holding up on our stack.

Emeka's pipeline generates the compression matrix cleanly: lossless x264, then re-encode at target CRF, frames extracted at 10fps — exactly the release recipe. CRF30 and CRF35 sets are built; eval running now.

Early risk: at CRF35 the gains compress to +0.2 dB and temporal shimmer appears in high-motion clips (walk especially). If that holds, the product claim needs a quality floor — "enhancement for moderately compressed uploads" rather than everything. Worth deciding before we write LRB materials.

Tereza
